svg.title: Build AP from predictions ranked by confidence
svg.desc: Illustrative example: two ground-truth dogs and IoU fixed at 0.50. The ranked predictions are TP, FP, TP. Precision is 1, 1/2, 2/3 and recall is 1/2, 1/2, 1. COCO 101-point interpolated AP is approximately 0.8349835.
svg.metadata: Text outlines use Noto Sans CJK. Diagram authored for this article.

g.aria-label: Build AP from predictions ranked by confidence
Two ground-truth dogs · One class · IoU fixed at 0.50
At each recall threshold, choose the best precision at that recall or higher.
COCO AP: mean precision at 101 recall thresholds
Illustrative calculation. Do not average the three observed precision values.
